ns_priest.text: Welcome. The Church of Cyprus is one of the oldest in the world: it has governed itself since the fifth century. The icons on the screen are windows, we say, not pictures.
There were churches in the north and mosques in the south, and there still are. Some are used, some are empty, some are being mended by people from both sides together. That's worth a candle.

ns_candles.text: You light a candle, you say a prayer, you push in front of nobody. That's the whole of the etiquette, love.
